item.title: My First Week in Seoul
item.summary: An Uzbek student writes a blog post about her first week on a Korean language course in Seoul.
item.content_markdown:
## Week one: hello, Seoul!

I arrived in Seoul last Sunday. The flight from Tashkent was long, and I was very tired, but I couldn't sleep because I was so excited.

My language course started on Monday. There are fourteen students in my class, from eight different countries. Our teacher, Ms Park, speaks only Korean in the lessons. On the first day, I understood almost nothing! By Friday, it was easier. Now I can order food, ask for directions and say where I'm from.

I live in a student dormitory near the university. My room is smaller than my bedroom at home, but it is clean and warm. My roommate is from Kazakhstan, so we speak Russian when we are tired of Korean.

The food is spicier than Uzbek food. I miss my mum's plov! But I love kimbap, and it is cheap.

Next weekend, I'm going to visit a palace with my classmates. I'm going to take lots of photos for you!
